result.summary: Found 1 clear visual defect: an invalid delivery fee value is rendered as '€NaN' for one restaurant. Horizontal carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport partial cards were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery price, exposing an unformatted/undefined numeric value to users.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery fee before rendering; use a fallback such as '€0.00', 'Free', or hide the delivery label when the value is missing or not a number.
